checks.statement: A dismissible standard drawer opens and closes through its visible menu control; a permanently visible drawer cannot be dismissed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Visibility: A dismissible standard drawer opens and closes through its visible menu control; a permanently visible drawer

evidence.result: The template includes an external opener only for the modal dialog variant. Standard drawer cases render the navigation directly and have no visible menu control or dismissible state handler.

implementation.notes: The required standard-drawer control behavior is absent from the specimen runtime; it cannot show a dismissible/permanent standard drawer distinction.

checks.statement: Allow a modal navigation drawer to close when its scrim is selected.
checks.condition: When a modal drawer is open.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Closing: Allow a modal navigation drawer to close when its scrim is selected.

evidence.result: A click on the native dialog backdrop targets the dialog outside its bounding rectangle; the click handler detects that coordinate and calls dialog.close().

implementation.notes: The native modal drawer closes when its scrim/backdrop is activated.

checks.statement: Anchor a side drawer to the start edge: left in LTR and right in RTL.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Sheet: Anchor a side drawer to the start edge: left in LTR and right in RTL.

evidence.result: Modal placement uses physical left (`inset: 0 auto 0 0`) instead of the logical inline-start edge, so RTL does not move the drawer to the right.

implementation.notes: The CSS placement is left-anchored for both directions; it does not implement the required RTL start edge.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Usage: Avoid pairing a drawer with another primary navigation component; choose one pattern by breakpoint: bar for co

evidence.result: The isolated component specimen has no application policy or surrounding route state to satisfy the condition “When selecting primary navigation.”.

implementation.notes: The source instruction is “Avoid pairing a drawer with another primary navigation component; choose one pattern by breakpoint: bar for compact, rail for medium/expanded, standard drawer for expanded and larger.” under “When selecting primary navigation.”. This requires app-level layout, routing, destination hierarchy, or product-selection context that this component specimen does not own. Disposition applies only to that integration condition.

checks.statement: On touch, show the active indicator and ripple and change the selected icon from outlined to filled and darker. On cursor hover, show the hover indicator; on click show the ripple and filled icon, adjusting icon brightness for light or dark theme.
checks.condition: When a destination is tapped, hovered or clicked.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated explicit Interaction & style guidance: On touch, show the active indicator and ripple and change the selected icon from outlined to filled and darker

evidence.result: Shared feedback recognizes .md-nav-item and injects an animated ripple into its indicator. Selection updates aria-current and navigation CSS switches outlined/filled glyphs. Generated drawer hover selectors bind state opacity and active icon/label colors separately; their component aliases follow the selected appearance. The generic authored hover exclusion does not remove these drawer-specific generated rules.

checks.statement: Place the modal scrim directly behind the drawer sheet so it blocks the rest of the app and can be activated to dismiss.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Scrim (modal only): Place the modal scrim directly behind the drawer sheet so it blocks the rest of the app and can be activated t

evidence.result: The native modal dialog creates a backdrop behind the dialog sheet and browser modal semantics block interaction with the rest of the page.

implementation.notes: The modal drawer uses a native dialog whose ::backdrop is painted behind the drawer; click-to-dismiss is assessed separately.

checks.statement: Require concise labels that do not wrap; truncate only when necessary rather than shrinking text. If using icons, put them before labels and use them for every destination or none.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Label text and icons: Require concise labels that do not wrap; truncate only when necessary rather than shrinking text. If using ico

evidence.result: The sample uses concise single-word labels, renders an icon before each label, and keeps the indicator contents in a non-wrapping label flow.

implementation.notes: The specimen uses short labels, consistent leading icons and a single-line text style; it does not shrink text.

checks.statement: Scroll drawer destinations independently while the rest of the screen remains stationary.
checks.condition: When drawer contents exceed its height.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Scrolling: Scroll drawer destinations independently while the rest of the screen remains stationary.

evidence.result: The standard drawer has no constrained block size or overflow container. Only modal dialogs scroll as one whole dialog; destinations do not have an independent scroll region while the page remains fixed.

implementation.notes: The stated independent destination scrolling behavior is not implemented for standard or modal drawer contents.
